VENDOR EVALUATION · Error tracking

| Vendor | Cost | Fit | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sentry | Low entry price; usage-based scaling | Broadest SDKs; tracing, replay included | Quota overages need monitoring |
| Rollbar | Mid; event-volume tiers | Solid grouping; simpler, errors-focused | Smaller ecosystem and slower innovation |
| Bugsnag | Mid-high; per-seat/event tiers | Strong mobile stability scoring | Pricier; fewer extras (SmartBear-owned) |

Recommendation: Sentry
